A1.justification: Both PDFs describe VesselTok and contain readable main text, references, and appendices A–J. Their equations, tables, and figures support comparison, including material relocated between sections.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, generalization, generation, link-prediction, radius-regression, and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and additionally reports graph-extraction sensitivity tests and Jaccard/SEAL link-prediction comparisons.

M1.justification: The centerline-conditioned occupancy VAE, FPS queries, attention architecture, BCE-plus-KL objective, skeleton-based graph extraction, EDM generation, and conditional flow-matching infill remain unchanged. Expanded descriptions do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same airway, cerebral, and pulmonary training datasets, TopCoW and renal evaluation, sagittally clipped anatomies, and reconstruction/generation/infill tasks. Additional renal-data citations do not establish new evaluated coverage; the new sensitivity tests concern retained ATM data.

E2.justification: v2 Appendix J/Table 11 adds Jaccard and SEAL comparisons for ATM link prediction, supplementing the retained autodecoder comparison in Table 5. Reconstruction and generation comparator sets remain unchanged, making this a limited expansion within one downstream task.

E3.justification: New evaluations vary thresholds from 0.40–0.60, use Voreen skeletonization, and compare 512, 640, and 768 grid resolutions. Conditional morphology evaluation adds edge-angle and tortuosity metrics. Appendix A revises validation/test totals from 152/230 to 147/235, matching the unchanged per-dataset counts in Table 8; this does not establish an actual resplit or rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix J substantially revises supplementary validation: v2 adds graph-extraction sensitivity tests, removes the nearest-neighbor memorization check, and expands conditional morphology analysis to angles and tortuosity while dropping unconditional property comparisons. Existing latent-size, pseudo-radius, graph-structure, and size-versus-complexity analyses are retained; the last is relocated.

E5.justification: Both versions report three ATM runs with different seeds, clDice variance of 0.028, and paired Wilcoxon significance at p < 0.001. Figure 10's interquartile-range reporting is also unchanged. No new repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice is introduced.

E6.justification: Table 4 revises all three methods' unconditional Betti MMD/coverage results. VesselTok's MMD values change from 7.25/1.01 to 78.36/2.64 and coverage from 0.95/0.73 to 0.32/0.18, retaining its leading ranking. Hunyuan3D's ATM component error changes from 0.011 to 0.11 in v1 Table 3/v2 Table 2. v2 also adds sensitivity, link-baseline, and compression-ratio results, replaces conditional morphology scores, and removes reconstruction averages, novelty scores, and unconditional morphology scores. Ablation prose is corrected, while the main per-dataset reconstruction and unseen-anatomy results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The graph-occupancy construction, projection/distance definitions, VAE loss, compression ratio, clDice, and Betti-error mathematics remain equivalent. Equation numbering and metric notation are revised without new derivations, assumptions, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims: compact graph tokenization, generalization across anatomies, conditional/unconditional generation, and downstream link prediction. The expanded introduction explains the existing contribution.

C2.justification: v2 qualifies reconstruction superiority from all datasets and metrics to most, acknowledges competitive rather than uniformly superior topology metrics, and replaces the claim that augmentation ensures SE(3) equivariance with improved robustness. It expands the sampling-budget explanation and interprets the new extraction and link-baseline tests. The size-versus-complexity limitation already existed in v1.

D1.justification: v2 explicitly states that pseudo-radius 0.016 is global across experiments and that infill masks are resampled each training iteration but fixed for validation/test. These clarify existing procedures. Runtime/memory measurements and the repository URL are relocated existing information, not newly available resources.

R1.justification: v2 adds Kuo et al. and Yagis et al. for renal-data attribution and Zhang and Chen for SEAL, while removing Prabhakar et al.'s 2025 paper on semantically consistent discrete diffusion. The broader positioning against graph, shape, and vessel tokenizers remains intact.

P1.justification: v2 expands the introductory rationale, reorders the pseudo-radius and latent-space ablations, moves the existing complexity discussion into a main-text Limitation paragraph, relocates runtime details, and edits metric explanations. Most prose and the overall section structure are retained.

P2.justification: The fourteen figure images are retained, with some relocation and renumbering, including Figures 6/7. Table 1 is reordered and loses its average block; Table 8 gains a compression column. Appendix tables are added, removed, or restructured for the revised analyses, without a broad visual redesign.

improvement.justification: v2 better aligns performance interpretations with the tables, clarifies reproducibility details, and adds relevant link-prediction baselines and extraction-sensitivity evidence. These improve reporting accuracy and confidence in the evaluation. Removing the nearest-neighbor novelty check and unconditional morphology comparisons reduces some generative validation, but the added controls and corrections support a limited net improvement.
